definition: A directive takes an action under, reports on, or formally continues, changes, or ends an IEEPA-linked emergency outside the vesting clause.
inclusion_rules: Require an outside-vesting IEEPA name or abbreviation plus a restriction; economic action; declaration; continuation; termination; report; notice; or transmittal action. In a reporting letter, the first-person report/transmittal and IEEPA reference may occur in separate text windows.
exclusion_rules: A historical or incidental IEEPA discussion with no identified lifecycle or operative action; an IEEPA reference appearing only in the removed vesting clause; a non-first-person or prospective report mention.

definition: A directive blocks or freezes property or imposes an operative trade/transaction restriction.
inclusion_rules: Require blocking/freezing tied to property; interests in property; assets; or transfer restrictions; or a directive-form restriction whose subject is imports; exports; transactions; investment; trade; entry; dealings; or covered goods.
exclusion_rules: Bank or agency names; quoted or proposed legal restrictions; general sanctions policy or reporting without a restriction; seizure or forfeiture without blocking/freezing; incidental discussion.
overlap_policy: May overlap IEEPA and emergency action.

definition: A directive itself formally declares; continues; renews; expands; modifies; revokes; or terminates an emergency legal status.
inclusion_rules: Require a current directive-form action verb tied to emergency status, or a formal notice/report that says the emergency is to continue in effect.
exclusion_rules: Preparedness policy; emergency response operations; emergency assistance funds; emergency-budget designations; policy responses that merely recite an emergency; recitals of a previously declared emergency; reports that do not formally alter or continue status; incidental emergency references.
overlap_policy: May overlap IEEPA; blocking; and trade.

definition: A directive establishes; proclaims; designates; reserves; enlarges; reduces; or modifies a national monument.
inclusion_rules: Require an operative action affecting a national monument or its reserved lands/objects.
exclusion_rules: Commemorative monuments; monument reports; parks or memorials without a national-monument action.
overlap_policy: Normally independent but overlap is permitted.

definition: A proclamation changes tariffs; duties; quotas; preferences; import treatment; trade-agreement implementation; or the Harmonized Tariff Schedule.
inclusion_rules: Require proclamation document type and an operative adjustment/implementation action tied to a trade mechanism, including tariff or import adjustments.
exclusion_rules: World Trade Week and similar ceremonial proclamations; general trade discussion; agriculture/manufacturing observances.
overlap_policy: May overlap IEEPA and emergency action.
